span.p: Any endpoint raises

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Committed native action type?
One controller dispatch at a time

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Validate command and endpoint-specific invariants
Fair-action guard requires original connected actor,
normal speed and no cheats

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Request native path and use walking_state
Bounded safe detours; no obstacle destruction
Blocked routes cool down

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Retain observed target and entity token
Check cursor visibility and native reach
Walk to approach only when needed

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Set native mining_state and count real gain
After depletion with progress, reacquire locally
Mine only the remaining committed quantity

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Find buildable site and direction
Walk only if outside native build reach
Build from carried cursor item; verify debit

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Look up owned role; approach if needed
Check reach, source and destination capacity
Move paid items; write exact unit-bound receipt
Partial quantity raises after receipt is stored

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Discover compatible fluid ports or pole endpoints
Bound route search and reject impossible preflight
Place carried pipes or small electric poles

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Queue unlocked native handcraft
Require idle queue and directly supplied ingredients
Receipt adapter tracks supported craft jobs

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Approach machine; require unlocked recipe
Refuse reconfiguration with buffered ingredients

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Start available research without canceling another
Labs consume real science packs

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Prepare paid landing pad, payload or fish
when requested by launch-readiness commands
Approach ready silo and request native launch

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Optional adapters build one paid component:
output chest/inserter; iron or copper outpost;
bounded ore belt route or production site
Receipt and native flow remain to be verified

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Ore input routes are bounded iron/copper layouts
No general coal-belt or downstream
transport network is implemented here

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Wait / idle returns without advancing game time
Production and research continue in the engine

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Generate bounded normal map terrain
No synthetic resource grants

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Bind existing player and character
Adapter attachment stops old controls
Reject unreconciled legacy work

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Walking/mining polls fair.observe
Each successful poll renews a 180-tick lease
Sleep 0.1 seconds between RPCs
Default wall-clock wait limit: 180 seconds

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p: Native control result?

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Finally stop walking/mining controls
Lease expiry, changed actor, stalled progress
or timeout can leave compound action ambiguous

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Adapter returned; success is not yet verified
Legacy FLE act may return an error string
Controller observes the required postcondition

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Factory adapter raised an error
Controller distinguishes exact preflight rejection
from a potentially partial mutation
